Player.label: 播放器
Player.step-tips: 当使用<1/>或<3/>时跳过的关键帧数
Player.You will be able to navigate and restore: 你可以浏览恢复删除的帧

Workspace.label: 工作区
Workspace.show-interpolated-tips: 在边栏显示隐藏的插补对象
Workspace.show-text-always-tips: 不止在画布中显示激活对象的文本
Workspace.auto-borders-tips: 绘制或编辑多边形和折线时，启用自动边缘
Workspace.intelligent-polygon-cropping-tips: 尝试在编辑时自动裁剪多边形
Workspace.Show frame tags in the corner of the wor: 工作区角落显示框架标签
Workspace.aam-zoom-margin: 属性注释模式 (AAM) 缩放余量
Workspace.approx-poly-threshold-tips: 值越大保留的多边形细节越多。用于 serverless 交互标注、OpenCV 剪刀和多边形简化
Workspace.adaptive-zoom-tips: 启用更平滑的缩放，兼容触控板与捏合手势

Shortcuts.label: 快捷键
Shortcuts.warning: 快捷键可由任何修饰符(alt, ctrl, or shift)组合, 最后加上非修饰符。某些组合键可能会被浏览器保留，不能在 CVAT 覆盖
SWITCH_SHORTCUTS: Open/hide the list of available shortcuts
TOGGLE_ANNOTATION_PAGE: The grid is used to UI development
SWITCH_COLOR_BY_APPEARANCE: Objects color mode may be by object, label, or group
TOGGLE_SHOW_BITMAP_APPEARANCE: Show or hide the bitmap layer on the canvas
PASTE_SHAPE: Paste a shape from internal CVAT clipboard
SWITCH_DRAW_MODE_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Repeat the latest procedure of drawing with the same parameters
SWITCH_REDRAW_MODE_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Remove selected shape and redraw it from scratch
SWITCH_GROUP_MODE_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to grouping shapes
RESET_GROUP_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Reset group for selected shapes (in group mode)
SWITCH_MERGE_MODE_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to merging shapes
SWITCH_SPLIT_MODE_STANDARD_3D_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to splitting shapes
SWITCH_SLICE_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate a mode to slice a polygon/mask
CLOCKWISE_ROTATION_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Change active rectangle or ellipse orientation clockwise by 90°, or rotate the image if none is active
ANTICLOCKWISE_ROTATION_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Change active rectangle or ellipse orientation counterclockwise by 90°, or rotate the image if none is active
SWITCH_DRAW_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Repeat the latest procedure of drawing with the same parameters
SWITCH_REDRAW_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Remove selected shape and redraw it from scratch
SWITCH_GROUP_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to grouping shapes
RESET_GROUP_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Reset group for selected shapes (in group mode)
SWITCH_MERGE_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to merging shapes
SWITCH_SPLIT_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate mode to splitting shapes
SWITCH_JOIN_MODE_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate or deactivate a mode where you can join polygons and masks
OPEN_REVIEW_ISSUE: Create a new issues in the review workspace
SWITCH_LOCK: Change locked state for an active object
SWITCH_OCCLUDED: Change occluded property for an active object
SWITCH_PINNED: Change pinned property for an active object
NEXT_KEY_FRAME: Go to the next keyframe of an active track
PREV_KEY_FRAME: Go to the previous keyframe of an active track
SWITCH_DRAW_MODE_TAG_ANNOTATION: Add a new tag, corresponding to the selected label.
SWITCH_DRAW_MODE_SINGLE_SHAPE: Repeat the latest procedure of drawing with the same parameters
DELETE_OBJECT_SINGLE_SHAPE: Delete an active object. Use shift to force delete of locked objects
ACTIVATE_BRUSH_TOOL_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate brush tool on masks drawing toolbox
ACTIVATE_ERASER_TOOL_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate eraser tool on masks drawing toolbox
ACTIVATE_POLYGON_TOOL_STANDARD_CONTROLS: Activate polygon tool on masks drawing toolbox
ACTIVATE_POLYGON_REMOVE_TOOL_STANDARD_CO: Activate polygon remove tool on masks drawing toolbox
SWITCH_AUTOMATIC_BORDERING: Toggle automatic snap to contour for polygons and polylines during drawing/editing
SWITCH_SNAP_TO_POINT: Toggle automatic snapping to nearby points
NEXT_OBJECT: Go to the next object and center it on the canvas
PREVIOUS_OBJECT: Go to the previous object and center it on the canvas
FOCUS_INPUT_FRAME: Focus on the element to change the current frame
SEARCH_FRAME_BY_NAME: Open search frame by name dialog
UNDO: Cancel the latest action related with objects
SWITCH_TOOLS_BLOCKER_STATE: Postpone running the algorithm for interaction tools
SEARCH_FORWARD: Search the next frame that satisfies to the filters
SEARCH_BACKWARD: Search the previous frame that satisfies to the filters
SAVE_JOB: Submit unsaved changes of annotations to the server
CANCEL_SKELETON_EDGE: Interrupts drawing a new skeleton edge
